messages:
kelly (Customer Ops): Heads-up :wave: Nightly deploy scheduled for runtime v2.3.1 across regions (us-east, eu-west, ap-southeast). Change window 00:30-02:00 UTC tonight. Canary in us-east, then progressive roll to other regions. Drafting statuspage + customer email below — pls review.
ben (Support Lead): Thanks. Can we add a note about possible transient 502s during cache warmup? Customers will ask.
carla (SRE): Good call. Add: "Minor transient 5xx errors possible for ~5-10m in each region while caches fill." Rollback triggers: sustained >0.5% 5xx for 10m or error spike on critical routes (/v1/chat, /v1/generate).
alice (Eng Release Manager): Also: pin strategy for Dedicated customers — we will NOT auto-upgrade dedicated pools to 2.3.1. They'll remain pinned at 2.3.0 unless they opt-in. Public hosted API will get 2.3.1 rollout. Include that in comms.
dave (Platform): Ops checklist: preflight runbook executed at 23:45 UTC. Canary load test at 00:05 UTC. If canary passes -> roll. If canary fails -> hold and escalate to oncall.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job 1717655600 created by alice, target runtime: v2.3.1, regions: [us-east, eu-west, ap-southeast], canary-size: 2%. Job ID: deploy-1717655600
ben (Support Lead): Draft statuspage snippet below. Short + specific.
ben (Support Lead): ```
Scheduled maintenance: Nightly runtime deployment (v2.3.1)
Window: 00:30 - 02:00 UTC
Impact: Minimal. Some customers may see brief transient errors (~5-10m) while caches warm.
Notes: Dedicated customers are not auto-upgraded; contact support to opt-in.
```
carla (SRE): Add rollback contact + incident playbook link. Also include expected degraded routes.
ben (Support Lead): Updated snippet with contact + playbook.
ben (Support Lead): ```
Scheduled maintenance: Nightly runtime deployment (v2.3.1)
Window: 00:30 - 02:00 UTC
Impact: Minimal. Temporary 5xx possible (~5-10m) during cache warmup.
Affected endpoints: /v1/chat, /v1/generate (short spikes possible)
Dedicated: Not auto-upgraded; pinned to v2.3.0 unless you opt-in.
If you experience sustained errors, contact support: support@redwood.ai or status.redwood.ai/incidents
Runbook: https://intranet.redwood.ai/playbooks/runtime-deploy
```
alice (Eng Release Manager): OK. Release notes bot — include brief list of notable fixes: memory regression fix, batcher timeout tuning, kernel update. Also mention metrics to watch: 95p latency, 99p latency, 5xx rate, token throughput.
release-notes-bot: draft release notes generated: "v2.3.1: fixes memory leak in KV cache, improves batcher backpressure, updates CUDA kernels for smaller sequence overhead."
carla (SRE): Canary pass criteria: no >=0.2% increase in 5xx, CPU/GPU utilization within expected range, no latency regression >10% on 95p.
dave (Platform): Ops will push statuspage at T-30m and send customer digest T-15m. Support to prepare canned responses for common q: "Are dedicated pools being upgraded?" and "What if I need to opt-in?"
ben (Support Lead): I'll prepare canned replies. Copy for webchat: "We are performing a routine runtime update to v2.3.1. Hosted customers will be upgraded; Dedicated customers remain on v2.3.0 unless they request an upgrade. Expect brief transient errors while caches warm. Contact support if issues persist."
kelly (Customer Ops): Email template (short): ```
Subject: Planned runtime update (v2.3.1) — Tonight 00:30-02:00 UTC
Body: Hi — We will deploy a runtime update to hosted inference (v2.3.1) during the window above. Impact is expected to be minimal; some customers may see transient 5xx for a few minutes while caches warm. Dedicated customers are not auto-upgraded. For questions or to opt-in dedicated pools, reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai.
```
carla (SRE): Final note: if canary shows any anomaly -> immediate hold and rollback plan activated: revert traffic, roll back runtime to 2.3.0 image, open incident channel. We'll call it in the runbook at 00:20 if needed.
deploy-bot: canary run started at 00:05 UTC (deploy-1717655600)
deploy-bot: canary health checks: 200/200 success, 95p latency within baseline, 5xx rate 0.03% (within threshold). Canary -> PASS
alice (Eng Release Manager): Good. Proceeding with staged rollout at 00:20 UTC. Support on standby.
ben (Support Lead): Support on standby. I've uploaded canned replies to Zendesk macros.
kelly (Customer Ops): Statuspage updated at T-30m with snippet above. Email queued for T-15m.
carla (SRE): Monitoring: will watch token throughput and model memory for the first 20m in each region.
dave (Platform): Post-deploy note: if any Dedicated customer opens a request to opt-in, route to account team and tag with "runtime-upgrade-optin".
ben (Support Lead): One more addition to statuspage: "If you rely on low-latency SLAs, consider reaching out to account team before opting in." Adding now.
kelly (Customer Ops): All set. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
